## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Platform Link Extraction**: Resolves Twitter/X, GIPHY, Tenor, Reddit, Imgur, Discord, Pinterest, and direct `.gif` / `.mp4` / `.webp` URLs without requiring any social media login.
- **Local Video & GIF Uploads**: Convert local MP4, WebM, MOV, GIF, and WebP files up to 50 MB.
- **Strict WhatsApp Spec Compliance**: Exact 512x512 pixel resolution, alpha transparency padding or square crop, adaptive multi-pass libwebp compression strictly under 500 KB, infinite looping.
- **Embedded WhatsApp EXIF Metadata**: Injects valid WhatsApp sticker pack ID, pack name, publisher author, and emoji tags into the WebP container.
- **Cross-Platform Export**: Drag-and-drop `.webp` for WhatsApp Web/Desktop, 1-tap mobile save + WhatsApp import, `.wastickers` pack download, and companion Android app.
- **Free & Pro Tiers**: Free daily conversions with zero watermarks; optional TwitSticker Pro unlocks unlimited daily stickers, priority queue, 6s / 20 FPS clips, meme text captions, white outline/rounded/circle borders, reverse/boomerang loops, custom EXIF branding, and an ad-free studio.

## Technical Specifications for WhatsApp Animated Stickers
- Resolution: Exactly 512x512 pixels
- Format: Animated WebP (`image/webp`) with alpha transparency
- Max File Size: Strictly under 500 KB (including EXIF metadata)
- Frame Rate: 10–14 FPS (Free), up to 20 FPS (Pro)
- Recommended Duration: 2.0–3.5 seconds (up to 6.0s on Pro; WhatsApp max 10s)
